StackType.rationale: PowerStackType.Counter. The sim has no StackType concept; Power.on_stack (powers.py:137-140) adds unconditionally, which is what PowerCmd.ModifyAmount does (PowerCmd.cs:236). Third-file citations, not hashed here.

AfterSideTurnEnd.issue: The removal condition is inverted from a side comparison into a hard-coded side. FlameBarrierPower.cs:26-32 removes the power whenever `base.Owner.Side != side` -- i.e. at the end of the turn belonging to the side the owner is NOT on, which for a player-held Flame Barrier is the enemy side's end and for an enemy-held one is the PLAYER side's end. The sim only implements on_enemy_side_end (powers.py:1026), so an enemy holding Flame Barrier keeps it forever. DORMANT: the only ported applier is the Ironclad card (Flame Barrier is a player card, so the owner is always the player and the enemy-side-end leg is the right one). Named trigger: any monster or effect that puts Flame Barrier on an enemy -- at which point the sim needs an on_player_turn_end / after_player_turn_end leg exactly as ConstrictPower and DemisePower carry (powers.py:1882-1884, :5010-5012). Also note the sim uses _expire() where C# uses PowerCmd.Remove; Flame Barrier overrides no AfterRemoved so the observable matches. Third-file citations, not hashed here.

guards.rationale: powers.py:1017 calls is_powered_attack(props) explicitly. This power gets the gate RIGHT where power/thorns and power/curl_up -- the same reflect-on-being-hit shape -- both drop it, which is what makes those two omissions omissions rather than a shared architectural absence.

guards.what: FlameBarrierPower.cs:22 dealer = base.Owner on the reflected damage
guards.rationale: powers.py:1021-1024 passes `dealer=self.owner` and DamageProps.NON_CARD_UNPOWERED (UNPOWERED alone -- blockable, matching C# omitting Unblockable). Contrast power/thorns, which drops the dealer.

guards.what: Flame Barrier fires even when the hit was fully blocked
guards.rationale: C# ignores the DamageResult entirely (`DamageResult _` at :18), so a fully blocked powered attack still burns; powers.py:1008-1024 likewise tests no amount. The sim's on_damage_received does fire at hp_lost == 0 (cmds.py's DamageCmd.deal is unconditional on amount before dispatching on_damage_received), so this holds.

guards.issue: Closed 2026-07-27: this guard existed only to carry the cross-reference to power/thorns at the same precedence, and the thorns finding is now closed -- ThornsPower moved onto the sim's real `before_damage_received` dispatch, so the two powers differ on the killing blow in the sim exactly as they do in the game. Flame Barrier itself never diverged here: both models hang the reflect on the AFTER-damage hook and both skip it on a kill (CreatureCmd.cs:392, and cmds.py's DamageCmd.deal guards `on_damage_received` with `if not target.is_dead`).
